subject: Vendor ops playbook + MSA redline for ProcurePlus onboarding
messages:
From: ProcurePlus Onboarding <onboarding@procureplus.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@vendorcorp.io>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: onboarding / vendor ops playbook for ProcurePlus

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for agreeing to run the vendor onboarding for ProcurePlus. We want to get live in Ariba in early December and need to align on the legal review, PO prefix mapping, and a minimal ops playbook for our SSO and EDI testers. Can you share your standard checklist and any redlines you expect at MSA/order form?

Quick context: ProcurePlus will issue POs from two different sub-IDs (PP-US and PP-EU). They'll expect a 7-day PO acknowledgement SLA and electronic invoice PDF attachment with each invoice.

High level asks from our side:
- Confirm what MSA/order form clauses typically require redline for our procurement team (insurance, data handling, audit rights)
- PO/EDI mapping example and expected file naming convention
- Signatory routing for order forms (DocuSign or internal signer)

I'll loop legal if needed — cc'd Alex from our vendor ops team.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Vendor Programs, ProcurePlus
Samantha.Lee@procureplus.com
Attachments: onboarding_requirements_v2.pdf (pdf stub)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@procureplus.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@vendorcorp.io>, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: onboarding / vendor ops playbook for ProcurePlus

Samantha — thanks and great to kick this off. Attached is our Ops Playbook checklist and the MSA with our current redlines (Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx). I put the likely legal asks as inline comments in the redline doc but summarized below for quicker review.

Summary (quick):
- Insurance: ProcurePlus requested additional insured — legal usually accepts certificate + carveout language; will need procurement sign-off on limits.
- Data handling: prefer customer-data carveout and limited logging retention (90 days) for hosted endpoints; private deployments can extend retention limits if requested and committed in order form.
- Audit rights: we can provide SOC2 report and scoped audit by request; full on-site audits require a separate SOW.

OPS / PO specifics:
- PO prefixes: we usually accept up to three prefixes; please confirm exact (PP-US / PP-EU). I'll attach a sample mapping file (po_prefix_map_example.csv).
- PO acknowledgements: we can honor 7-day ack SLA for standard orders if EDI routing is enabled; otherwise manual ack should be 48–72 hours.
- Invoice attachments: PDFs attached to EDI or uploaded to portal are OK; include invoice_number in filename.

Next steps:
1) Kimberley (legal) to review the attached redline and call out any absolute blockers.
2) Mateo (integration/ops) to validate EDI schema and prefix mapping.
3) I'll propose a joint 30-min sync Wed 11/18 at 11am PT — does that work for ProcurePlus?

Thanks,

— Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
Attachments: ProcurePlus_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx; Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx; po_prefix_map_example.csv

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@procureplus.com>
Cc: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff: onboarding / vendor ops playbook for ProcurePlus

Marissa / Samantha — I reviewed the redline and left three items we should confirm before legal signs off:

1) Insurance limits: ProcurePlus proposed $5M general liability and $10M cyber — we typically require $5M GL and $3M cyber; if ProcurePlus can provide evidence of umbrella coverage or higher cyber limits we can accept.

2) Data retention & egress: I can agree to 90-day retention on hosted with an option in the order form for private deployments to specify longer retention. Please ensure the OF has a checkbox for "extended retention" and related cost line.

3) Audit clause: we will not allow unrestricted onsite audits. We can offer a scoped document request + SOC2 review, and an option to negotiate an on-site audit in a separate SOW if they have regulatory needs.

Also: redline_v3 has an ambiguous indemnity subparagraph — I added a tracked change to revert to our standard language (see comment). If ProcurePlus's legal cannot accept, escalate to our GC for exception.

I don't see any other absolute blockers. If ProcurePlus confirms the insurance and retention pattern above, we should be able to proceed with signature and portal activation.

-Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Team — quick ops notes from my side after looking at the sample mapping:

- EDI/Ariba: ProcurePlus's PP-US/PP-EU prefixes map cleanly. We will create two vendor site entries in our Ariba test tenant and provide SFTP creds for EDI.
- PO numbering: ask ProcurePlus to include POSuffix (e.g. -001) for split shipments. We'll validate with a test PO this Friday.
- Signer routing: DocuSign envelope fine — please route the order form to the Redwood Legal mailbox for final signature after fields are auto-populated. Markus, can you confirm the DS template name?

ProcurePlus, can you confirm: 1) whether invoices will come via EDI or portal upload; 2) the exact sample filename convention you will use? If you can send one example invoice file, we'll run it through our parser now.

I'll be on the 11/18 11am PT sync but if we need an earlier deep-dive on the EDI mapping we can do a short call Thurs.

Thanks,
